faqs.question: Which syllabus do you teach?
faqs.answer: We provide coaching exclusively for the CBSE syllabus for Grade 10 and Grade 12 students.

faqs.question: Which grades are available?
faqs.answer: We currently offer coaching for Grade 10 and Grade 12 CBSE students.

faqs.question: Which subjects are taught?
faqs.answer: Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry are taught by experienced faculty members.

faqs.question: Who teaches Mathematics?
faqs.answer: The Founder with over 10 years of teaching experience handles Mathematics.

faqs.question: Who teaches Physics?
faqs.answer: An experienced guest faculty member with 15 years of teaching experience teaches Physics.

faqs.question: Who teaches Chemistry?
faqs.answer: Chemistry is taught by a guest faculty member with 7 years of teaching experience.

faqs.question: What are the class timings?
faqs.answer: Monday to Friday classes are conducted from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Sunday classes are held from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Saturday is a holiday.

faqs.question: Will study materials be provided?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every enrolled student receives worksheets, handwritten notes, revision materials, formula sheets, and previous year questions.

faqs.question: How often are tests conducted?
faqs.answer: Students attend daily practice tests, weekly assessments, monthly examinations, and model board examinations.

faqs.question: How can I enroll?
faqs.answer: You can visit the institute, contact us by phone, send a WhatsApp message, or submit the admission enquiry form through the website.

faqs.question: Can I visit the institute before admission?
faqs.answer: Yes. Parents and students are welcome to visit the institute during business hours.

faqs.question: How can I contact the institute?
faqs.answer: You can reach us by phone, WhatsApp, email, or by visiting the institute directly.
